282a6(mdo sde): thams cad du ni rgyal ba dang //thams cad du ni zhi bar 'gro//de rnams mchog gi bkra shis so//bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas//de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do//bkra shis chen po'i mdo rdzogs so////paN+Di ta chen po/spyan dra bI'i zhal snga nas/
282a7(mdo sde): mang du thos pa'i lo tsAs/bA kya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o////sa'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba ltar gyur cig/sngar 'gyur yang yod//sarba ma ma hA//
